voice.summary: SceneAI speaks like a creative collaborator who makes complicated things simple. It describes worlds in plain words and promises that lighting, camera and materials are handled.
dos: Invite people to describe a scene in plain words
Say what the system handles for you
Use vivid but concrete scene words
donts: Do not use technical rendering jargon
Never promise instant results without limits

taglines: Describe a world, watch it render
From a sentence to a scene
boilerplate: SceneAI is an AI tool that turns plain-language descriptions into 3D scenes, handling lighting, camera and materials so creators can build worlds in seconds.

microcopy.error: Could not build that scene. Try rewording it.
microcopy.empty: No scenes yet. Describe one to start.

logo.note: A cube stands for 3D scenes and builds into a crisp icon on a dark page.
